social_activities: Actively involved in social and cultural activities, Promotes education particularly in rural areas and supports initiatives for women empowerment. Participated in various cultural events to preserve and promote local traditions. Organized health camps and provided aid to the under privileged, fostering community development and social harmony.

other_information: Actively involved in abolition of the dowry system and ritual of serving food on 13th day after demise, prevention of child marriage and promotion of widow marriage; gives special attention to improving the quality of education; working for the upliftment of the poor, backward, dalits and minorities participated in the mass weddings; participated in the movements for the solution of regional problems and imprisoned many times.
